**Show all your reasoning.** Total: **48 marks** · Suggested time: **65 minutes**. No calculator. Every question
is exam standard.

| Section | What it covers | Marks |
|---|---|---|
| **A — Straight lines** | perpendicular lines · perpendicular bisector · normal to a curve | 10 |
| **B — One circle** | centre & radius · "is it a circle" · point vs circle · tangent line · line-meets-circle | 14 |
| **C — Two circles** | shortest distance · external tangency · radical axis (common chord) | 10 |
| **D — Properties & building circles** | chord distance · circle through 3 points · tangent length · centre on a line | 14 |

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Answer form.** Equations of lines → $ax+by+c=0$ or $y=mx+c$. Equations of circles →
$(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$. Coordinates → a point. "How many / inside–on–outside" → a word or number. Lengths and
$c$-values → **exact** (surd) form. Ranges of a constant → an **inequality**.
:::
